race.comment: SHYLEAH (7) has a moderate winning strike-rate but performed well last time at Moe, finishing fourth, less than a length from the winner at the end of 1000m when she made late ground. Peak fitness now. TANNA (4) clung on to finish second last start over 900m at Mt Gambier, beaten 1.5 lengths as favourite. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot take this out. CRACKLE 'N' BURN (5) returned from a spell three-and-a-half weeks ago when he was beaten 5.5 lengths into fifth over 900m at Mt Gambier. Fitter so anticipating a better run this time. LAURA'S GOLD (6) hasn't placed in five runs this time in, but she's been tackling much stronger races than this, so improvement would not shock.
